context: Two roommates argue about housekeeping habits
purpose: Teach: いかにも/網/打っ/満ち/回避/っぱなし/じっと/マル

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ちょっと、また電気つけっぱなしだったよ！いつも疲れたフリして、それ毎日じゃん。
lines.en: Hey, you left the lights on again! You always act tired, but it's literally every day.
lines.style: Frustrated teen girl scolding her roommate with rising irritation and sarcasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ごめんって。じっと机に向かって勉強してたら、つい忘れちゃっただけだよ。
lines.en: Sorry, sorry. I was staring at my desk studying and just totally forgot.
lines.style: Defensive teen boy mumbling excuses while avoiding eye contact, casual tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: シンクも見てよ。網の中、食べカスでいっぱいで、もう気持ち悪いんだけど。
lines.en: Look at the sink too. The strainer is packed with food scraps, it's gross.
lines.style: Disgusted teen girl pointing accusingly, voice climbing with exasperation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、マジか。あとで網を叩いて打って捨てとくから、そんな責めないでよ。
lines.en: Whoa, seriously? I'll tap the strainer out and toss it later, don't pile on me.
lines.style: Sheepish teen boy backpedaling with awkward laugh and raised hands.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 「あとで」って言って回避するの、もう何回目？今度こそマルつけて見せてよ、本当に。
lines.en: How many times have you dodged with 'later'? This time actually check it off for me.
lines.style: Sharp teen girl crossing arms, voice clipped with mounting accusation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: わかったよ、ちゃんとやる。今週は毎日マル入れるから、いかにも本気って顔してるでしょ？
lines.en: Okay, okay, I'll do it properly. I'll check it off daily this week, I look serious, right?
lines.style: Resigned teen boy holding up palms in surrender, softer conciliatory tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: その自信に満ちた顔、信じたいけど口だけじゃダメ。約束破ったら家賃の折半なしだからね。
lines.en: That confident face, I want to believe it, but words aren't enough. Break it, no split rent.
lines.style: Stern teen girl pointing finger with playful but serious warning edge.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: それだけは勘弁してよ！今日からじっと自分を見つめ直してちゃんとやるって！
lines.en: Anything but that, please! From today I'll quietly look at myself and shape up, I swear!
lines.style: Panicked teen boy clutching head with exaggerated comedic desperation.
